prompt: A slim toy staple blaster: a narrow red plastic stapler-like body with a visible spring and a short pull-back lever on top, a strip of silver staples feeding into it, staples fire out of the front. Small, slim and simple with only a few parts, about the length of a pencil, so it can clip under the wing of a paper airplane; a small clip on top to attach it. Shown alone, single object centred, side 3/4 view, plain cream background, soft studio light, no text, no logos, no grip, no paper airplane. Glossy molded plastic like a piece snapped off a toy soldier set, with a bit of masking tape.
